summary: Fraudsters posed as crypto buyers and directed a Hyderabad trader to a fake website under the pretext of completing KYC verification which triggered a malicious smart contract that transferred over two million USDT from his wallet to attacker controlled addresses.
user_mistake: Logged into a fraudulent KYC site and approved a malicious smart contract transaction
prevention: Access exchanges and wallet services only through manually typed official domains / Reject KYC requests received from unsolicited contacts
